summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Xtrackers Russell 1000 US Quality at a Reasonable Price ETF (QARP) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell 1000 Slowdown Factor index. The fund tracks and index of US large-cap companies, selected and weighted based upon a combination of quality and value metrics. Quality metrics are given greater weight. QARP was launched on Apr 5, 2018 and is issued by Xtrackers.

holdings.infoBox: QARP is an equity ETF with a total of 417 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 5.50%, Microsoft at 4.98%, Meta Platforms at 4.73%, Alphabet at 3.44%, and Berkshire Hathaway at 3.03%.
